.devcontainer/devcontainer.json.name: Dev container setup
.devcontainer/devcontainer.json.description: Prepares a ready-made coding workspace with the languages, tools and editor extensions needed to work on the platform.

api/Dockerfile.name: Server container image
api/Dockerfile.description: Builds the shipping server package used by the main server, background tasks and setup, with every dependency pinned for safety.

api/Dockerfile.dev.name: Dev server image
api/Dockerfile.dev.description: Builds a lean server image with dependencies only, so live code from your machine is mounted and reloads instantly.

api/entrypoint.sh.name: Server startup script
api/entrypoint.sh.description: Applies memory settings, fixes mounted folder permissions, then starts the server as an unprivileged user.

client/Dockerfile.name: Web app image
client/Dockerfile.description: Compiles the browser app and serves the finished screens from a small, hardened web server.

client/Dockerfile.dev.name: Dev web app image
client/Dockerfile.dev.description: Installs the browser app's dependencies once so edited screens refresh instantly during local work.

client/Dockerfile.playwright.name: Browser test image
client/Dockerfile.playwright.description: Prepares a container with a real browser and test runner so automated click-through checks can drive the app.

client/entrypoint.sh.name: Web app launcher
client/entrypoint.sh.description: Starts the live-reloading development web server for the browser app inside its container.

client/nginx.conf.name: Web server routing
client/nginx.conf.description: Serves the app's pages and assets and forwards requests meant for the main server, with caching and upload limits set.

docker-compose.debug.port.yml.name: Local port access
docker-compose.debug.port.yml.description: Exposes the local preview on an ordinary localhost port instead of a private network link.

docker-compose.debug.yml.name: Local preview stack
docker-compose.debug.yml.description: Runs a full private copy of the platform for one working folder, with live reload and storage that survives restarts.

docker-compose.dev.yml.name: Development overrides
docker-compose.dev.yml.description: Adds live reload, debug ports and convenient defaults on top of the standard stack for local work.

docker-compose.docs.yml.name: Docs screenshot overlay
docker-compose.docs.yml.description: Points the browser test runner at the documentation project so fresh product screenshots land in the docs.

docker-compose.test.yml.name: Test stack
docker-compose.test.yml.description: Runs a throwaway copy of the platform with a fresh database for automatic checks, separate from the preview stack.

docker-compose.yml.name: Production stack
docker-compose.yml.description: Describes a real installation: database, cache, file storage, main server, background tasks and web app.
